question: For a binary-produced counted NUL in the original called-name or required/default/reference formal, which exact definition completion and wrong-argument usage does each authentic C Tcl8.4–9.1/current Jim interpreter publish, including whether later formal names remain in the error?
problem: Called-name and formal storage extents are separate from diagnostic usage extents. Current Jim duplicates the called object, appends required formal names as C strings but default formal names as counted objects, then formats the entire usage through snprintf. Applying one final boundary to every formal can drop later names incorrectly. A shared formal-usage owner must follow the measured native construction rather than infer from lookup/storage bytes.
